high_level_description: This image is a screenshot of an Instagram post from the account "thecosmologicalway." The post features a satellite view of Earth, showcasing its blue oceans and green landmasses. The caption below the image reads: THE EARTH The Earth, also known as the Blue Planet, is a home for millions of species, including humans. The Earth is the only place in the universe where life is known to exist. The planet is formed 4.54 billion years ago. The first living organisms populate planet Earth around 3.5 billion years ago.
